verdict.rationale: Skyfire documents per-agent API keys scoped to a single Buyer or Seller agent, and agents can be restricted to set source IP addresses. Its pay tokens are bounded credentials with committed amount ceilings, expiry windows from 10 seconds to 24 hours, and disclosure of only the identity fields a service requires. However, API-key scoping is coarse (per agent, with no documented permission granularity), and revocation is limited: no per-token revocation API, and in-flight tokens stay chargeable after deactivation. Missing for 10: fine-grained permission scopes on API keys, per-token or per-key revocation, independent or hands-on corroboration of scoping enforcement.
